item.title: Severe bin store overflow and blocked access creating a public health and fire hazard., 11th October
item.description:
The communal bin store at Tideslea Path is completely full with uncollected rubbish and loose waste bags. The buildup completely blocks the entrance doors, making it impossible for residents to access the bins or dispose of waste safely. This presents an immediate fire risk, severe smell, and risk of pest infestation. Urgent clearance is required so standard bin collections can resume. It seems these bins haven't been emptied in the past few weeks.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Merbury Road, Thamesmead
